steps.detail: You arrive on a sunny island. Ahead is the conveyor belt with brainrots walking along it, and eight coloured bases ring the island.
steps.title: Spawn on Brainrot Bay

steps.detail: Walk up to a brainrot on the belt and press E. If you can afford it, it walks to your base and starts earning money per second.
steps.title: Buy a brainrot off the belt

steps.detail: Every brainrot on your base earns its $/s. The top bar shows your cash and income. Save up for rarer brainrots and shop upgrades.
steps.title: Watch your money grow

steps.detail: Walk onto someone else's base and press E on their brainrot to grab it, then run home and press E to place it. If they slap you (Q) you drop it.
steps.title: Steal from another base

steps.detail: Press F to lock your base for 60 seconds so nobody can steal from you. It has a 120 second cooldown, so time it well.
steps.title: Lock your base

steps.detail: Every 3 minutes a tsunami sweeps the island. The warning gives you 30 seconds to run back to your base platform, the only safe ground.
steps.title: Survive the tsunami

steps.detail: Spend cash in the shop on slots, speed, slap power, longer locks and income boosts, then rebirth for a permanent +25% income multiplier.
steps.title: Rebirth and grow
